options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: force_delete
options.description: This option overrides the error and allows the deletion to continue in case there are any vVols associated with the storage container. Use with great caution.

options.name: high_water_mark
options.description: This is the percentage of the quota that can be consumed before an alert is raised. This is used only for creating a storage container.

options.name: new_name
options.description: The new name of the storage container.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: quota
options.description: The total number of bytes that can be provisioned/reserved against this storage container. A value of C(0) means there is no limit. It is possible to set the quota to a value that overprovisions the amount of space available in the system.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the storage container should exist or not. For Delete operation only, it should be set to C(absent).

options.name: storage_container_destination
options.description: It contains details of remote system and remote storage container. It is required while creating and deleting storage container destinations.

options.name: storage_container_destination_state
options.description: Define whether the storage container destination should exist in the storage container. To delete storage container destination, it should be C(absent).

options.name: storage_container_id
options.description: The unique identifier of the storage container.

options.name: storage_container_name
options.description: Name for the storage container. This should be unique across all storage containers in the cluster.

options.name: storage_protocol
options.description: The type of storage container. C(SCSI) is set when a storage container is dedicated to C(SCSI) usage. C(NVMe) is set when a storage container is dedicated to C(NVMe) usage.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
